metadata.title: B2B Wholesale E-commerce Platform Residuality Stress Test
metadata.description: How Highbiza's platform must change when group strategy, ERP partners, search behaviour, regulation or suppliers shift.
metadata.naiveArchitecture: One Django/Oscar/Wagtail codebase per customer with point-to-point ERP scripts, prices copied nightly, carriers and payment providers wired into checkout code, and quality depending on a small team's knowledge.
metadata.residualArchitecture: A shared building-block platform with package entitlements, connectors behind a stable integration layer with mappings as data, event-based order and stock exchange that Katapull siblings can join, consumer-law features as configurable blocks, and automated QA gating every release.

stressors.name: Katapull consolidates storefronts around Logic4
stressors.detection: Group roadmap discussions; Logic4 already offers an integrated webshop and shares Highbiza's address.
stressors.attractor: Two storefront offerings in one group compete for the same wholesalers.
stressors.businessReaction: Position Highbiza as the storefront for demanding B2B/B2C shops on any ERP, and as the default front end for Logic4 customers who outgrow the built-in shop.
stressors.residue: Storefront capabilities exposed as building blocks that can sit on Logic4 or other ERPs via the integration layer.

impacts.effect: Group must still beat SaaS suites.

stressors.name: A major ERP changes or rate-limits its API
stressors.detection: Deprecation notices from Exact Online or Business Central; sync failure spikes.
stressors.attractor: Integrations break for many shops at once.
stressors.businessReaction: Isolate ERP specifics in connectors, monitor sync health and retry automatically.
stressors.residue: Connector mappings as data with versioned adapters and health monitoring.

stressors.name: Search traffic shifts to AI assistants
stressors.detection: Falling organic sessions despite stable rankings; buyers asking assistants for suppliers.
stressors.businessReaction: Publish structured product data and feeds that assistants and marketplaces can consume.
stressors.residue: Product data published as structured feeds from one catalogue.

stressors.name: EU consumer rules tighten online withdrawal and accessibility
stressors.detection: New consumer-law obligations and accessibility requirements for webshops.
stressors.attractor: Every consumer shop must change simultaneously.
stressors.businessReaction: Ship compliance features as shared blocks enabled for all shops (as with the 2026 Return Form Page).
stressors.residue: Compliance as configurable building blocks rolled out platform-wide.

media.title: Residuality stressor illustration: EU consumer rules tighten online withdrawal and accessibility

stressors.name: A payment provider fails during peak season
stressors.attractor: Checkouts fail and revenue is lost.
stressors.businessReaction: Allow a second provider per shop and fail over.
stressors.residue: Provider-agnostic payment layer with multiple active providers.

stressors.name: Founder-led knowledge leaves the team
stressors.detection: Customer cases mention direct relationships with the founder.
stressors.attractor: Customer intimacy and architectural knowledge concentrate in few people.
stressors.businessReaction: Codify building blocks, tests and runbooks; use group support capacity.
stressors.residue: Automated tests and documented blocks that make the platform team-independent.

media.title: Residuality stressor illustration: Founder-led knowledge leaves the team
media.alt: Illustration of the residuality stressor 'Founder-led knowledge leaves the team', showing its signal, attractor, business response, and surviving residue.

stressors.name: Large trade buyers demand EDI orders
stressors.detection: Tenders and buyers requiring EDI or punch-out.
stressors.attractor: Webshop-only ordering is excluded from large accounts.
stressors.businessReaction: Route EDI orders through Transus into the same order flow.
stressors.residue: EDI as another order channel feeding order management.

impacts.effect: Buyers can order from their own systems.
